parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all body parts available for associating with incident injuries. Supports filtering by selectable status.

parameters.name: filters[selectable]
parameters.description: If true, return item(s) with 'selectable' status.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier for this body part entry.

name.description: Machine-readable name of the body part (e.g. finger_index_right, shoulder_left). Use this value when associating body parts to injuries.

selectable.description: Represents whether a Body Part can be associated to an injury.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this body part record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to this body part record.

parent_id.description: Identifier of the parent body part in the anatomical hierarchy. Null for top-level body parts (e.g. hand is parent of finger).

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
